sonnet.problem: Jesus quotes Deuteronomy 6:4-5 here and Leviticus 19:18 on card 6, and Mark's wording differs from the Old Testament text. For example, Mark adds 'all your mind'. Neither card names the Old Testament source.
sonnet.rule: When the New Testament quotes the Old Testament in different words, the card names the source ("Paul quotes Psalm 18:49") but cites only the New Testament verse.
